evals.name: privilege-boundary-not-interactive-wizard
evals.prompt: The operator has to run Set-MachineConfiguration.ps1 elevated. Every step is scriptable. Write the script I will launch. Do not walk me through clicks.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses /wizard:unattended, not /wizard:generate. It emits PowerShell or bash from the fixed template, with elevation checked, a JSON result path, and no per-step confirmation. It does not run the script.
expectations: Chooses unattended rather than the interactive generate wizard
Names the JSON result the agent will read back

evals.name: dashboard-stays-on-generate
evals.prompt: I have to click through the Stripe dashboard and paste an API key. Build me the unattended script.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses the unattended shape for a dashboard click and routes to /wizard:generate, because a human is the actor, not only the privilege boundary.
expectations: Does not emit an unattended script for a dashboard click
